summary.text: Marlón Durán, a Green Party nominee, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Texas's 28th District to Henry Cuellar.
The San Antonio Report describes him as a progressive activist who has worked on local and federal campaigns.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, Durán was born in Mexico, and his family settled in McAllen, Texas, when he was eight years old; he has lived in the Rio Grande Valley since.
He has a degree in organizational leadership from South Texas College and works as a professional translator, according to the San Antonio Report.
He received 4.6% of the vote to Henry Cuellar's 65.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
